editionLabel: Next Move Games English World Tour rules
firstPlayerRule: For the first city, the last person who visited an art exhibition is the start player.
clarifications: Give that player the Start player card unless the city uses simultaneous play.
For later cities, the player with the fewest fans starts; if tied, the start player moves to the next player clockwise.

internalEvidence: The Next Move/Asmodee-hosted English PDF was inspected. PDF page 2 was rendered and read. It gives a criterion for the first city, then a different fan-count procedure for later cities. The World Tour title and components match inventory BGG 193042. uncertainty: Some cities use simultaneous play; their start player does not take a first individual turn.
No tie procedure is stated for people who last visited an exhibition together at the first city.
